summary: Completed live Open-Meteo API regression and browser demo-flow testing. Five API/persistence checks passed; the new clear-sky mapping regression correctly fails on the WMO-0 defect. Browser flow passed Hyderabad/Mumbai switching, live forecasts, persona recommendations, atmosphere state, and mobile layout.

critical.issue: weather_service.condition_for uses code or 3, so valid WMO code 0 (clear sky) is treated as code 3 (cloudy), producing incorrect condition and atmosphere for clear weather.

integration_issues.issue: Notification panel displays 'Heavy rain expected after 6 PM' and 'UV advisory for your area' despite no warning/advisory feed and unsupported UV data; this violates the no-fake-emergency-alert requirement.

action_items: Fix WMO code 0 handling so clear sky maps to sunny in condition_for.
Remove or explicitly label notification-panel weather claims as unavailable/integration-ready until a real alert/UV provider is connected.
critical_code_review_comments: The notification panel contains hard-coded unsupported weather alerts even though the live data contract explicitly marks official warnings and UV unavailable.
condition_for(code=0) currently returns cloudy because of truthiness fallback; use an explicit None check.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_mausam_review status record during the existing persistence regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live API and primary browser flow are covered. Recheck clear-sky WMO code 0 behavior and notification-center copy after fixes; Hyderabad and Mumbai selection, Farmer/Fitness recommendations, 24 hourly rows, 7 daily rows, rain atmosphere without lightning, and 390px overflow all passed.
rca of the issue: The condition bug is caused by Python truthiness in WMO_CONDITIONS.get(code or 3), where zero is replaced before lookup. The notification issue is caused by static strings rendered in App.js notification panel rather than values from a warning/advisory data source.
